<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Coin Hopper</title>
<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#111;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<script>
const W = 800, H = 480;

// Level data: platforms [x, y(top), w, h], coins [x, y], enemy patrol, goal flag
const LEVELS = [
  {
    width: 1600,
    platforms: [[0,440,500,40],[600,440,400,40],[1100,440,500,40],[300,340,120,16],[520,280,120,16],[760,330,120,16],[1000,270,120,16]],
    coins: [[360,300],[580,240],[820,290],[1060,230],[700,400],[1300,400]],
    enemy: { x: 1200, y: 420, min: 1120, max: 1560 },
    goal: [1550, 400], start: [60, 380]
  },
  {
    width: 2000,
    platforms: [[0,440,300,40],[420,440,200,40],[740,440,200,40],[1060,440,200,40],[1400,440,600,40],
                [300,350,80,16],[600,330,100,16],[900,300,100,16],[1250,330,100,16],[1100,220,120,16],[1500,320,120,16]],
    coins: [[340,310],[650,290],[950,260],[1150,180],[1300,290],[1550,280],[500,400],[1800,400]],
    enemy: { x: 1600, y: 420, min: 1420, max: 1960 },
    goal: [1950, 400], start: [60, 380]
  }
];

class Game extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Game'); }
  init(d) { this.level = d.level || 0; this.total = d.total || 0; }
  preload() {}
  create() {
    const g = this.make.graphics({ x: 0, y: 0, add: false });
    g.fillStyle(0x4fc3f7).fillRect(0, 0, 24, 32); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(14, 8, 6, 6);
    g.generateTexture('player', 24, 32); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0xffd54f).fillCircle(8, 8, 8); g.lineStyle(2, 0xf9a825).strokeCircle(8, 8, 7);
    g.generateTexture('coin', 16, 16); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0xe53935).fillRect(0, 0, 28, 24); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(5, 6, 6, 6).fillRect(17, 6, 6, 6);
    g.generateTexture('enemy', 28, 24); g.clear();
    g.fillStyle(0xeeeeee).fillRect(0, 0, 4, 48); g.fillStyle(0x66bb6a).fillTriangle(4, 0, 30, 10, 4, 20);
    g.generateTexture('flag', 30, 48);

    const L = LEVELS[this.level];
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#1b2838');
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, L.width, H + 200);
    this.cameras.main.setBounds(0, 0, L.width, H);

    this.platforms = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    L.platforms.forEach(([x, y, w, h]) => {
      const r = this.add.rectangle(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, w, h, 0x6d4c41).setStrokeStyle(2, 0x8bc34a);
      this.physics.add.existing(r, true); this.platforms.add(r);
    });

    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(L.start[0], L.start[1], 'player');
    this.player.setCollideWorldBounds(false).setMaxVelocity(300, 700);
    this.player.body.setGravityY(900);
    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.platforms);

    this.coins = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    L.coins.forEach(([x, y]) => this.coins.create(x, y, 'coin'));
    this.got = 0;
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coins, (p, c) => { c.destroy(); this.got++; this.total++; this.hud(); });

    const e = L.enemy;
    this.enemy = this.physics.add.sprite(e.x, e.y, 'enemy');
    this.enemy.body.setAllowGravity(false).setImmovable(true);
    this.enemy.setVelocityX(-70);
    this.eMin = e.min; this.eMax = e.max;
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemy, () => this.hitEnemy());

    this.flag = this.physics.add.staticSprite(L.goal[0], L.goal[1], 'flag');
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.flag, () => this.finish());

    this.cameras.main.startFollow(this.player, true, 0.1, 0.1);
    this.cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();
    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys('W,A,D,SPACE');
    this.jumps = 0; this.done = false;

    this.text = this.add.text(12, 10, '', { fontSize: '18px', color: '#fff' }).setScrollFactor(0);
    this.add.text(12, 36, 'Arrows/WASD move, Up/W/Space jump (double jump!), stomp the red guy', { fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa' }).setScrollFactor(0);
    this.hud();
  }
  hud() { this.text.setText(`Level ${this.level + 1}/${LEVELS.length}   Coins: ${this.got}/${LEVELS[this.level].coins.length}`); }
  hitEnemy() {
    if (this.done || !this.enemy.active) return;
    if (this.player.body.velocity.y > 0 && this.player.body.bottom < this.enemy.body.center.y + 4) {
      this.enemy.destroy(); this.player.setVelocityY(-380); this.jumps = 1;
    } else this.die();
  }
  die() {
    if (this.done) return; this.done = true;
    this.total -= this.got;
    this.cameras.main.shake(150, 0.01);
    this.time.delayedCall(250, () => this.scene.restart({ level: this.level, total: this.total }));
  }
  finish() {
    if (this.done) return; this.done = true;
    if (this.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) this.scene.restart({ level: this.level + 1, total: this.total });
    else this.scene.start('Win', { total: this.total });
  }
  update() {
    if (this.done) return;
    const p = this.player, c = this.cursors, k = this.keys;
    const left = c.left.isDown || k.A.isDown, right = c.right.isDown || k.D.isDown;
    p.setVelocityX(left ? -220 : right ? 220 : 0);
    if (left) p.setFlipX(true); else if (right) p.setFlipX(false);
    if (p.body.blocked.down) this.jumps = 0;
    const jp = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(c.up) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.W) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.SPACE);
    if (jp) {
      if (p.body.blocked.down) { p.setVelocityY(-450); this.jumps = 1; }
      else if (this.jumps < 2) { p.setVelocityY(-420); this.jumps = 2; }
    }
    if (this.enemy.active) {
      if (this.enemy.x <= this.eMin) this.enemy.setVelocityX(70);
      else if (this.enemy.x >= this.eMax) this.enemy.setVelocityX(-70);
    }
    if (p.y > H + 100) this.die();
  }
}

class Win extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Win'); }
  init(d) { this.total = d.total; }
  create() {
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#1b5e20');
    const t = (y, s, size) => this.add.text(W / 2, y, s, { fontSize: size + 'px', color: '#fff', align: 'center' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    t(160, 'YOU WIN!', 64);
    const all = LEVELS.reduce((n, l) => n + l.coins.length, 0);
    t(250, `Coins collected: ${this.total}/${all}`, 28);
    const r = t(340, 'Press ENTER or click to play again', 20);
    this.tweens.add({ targets: r, alpha: 0.3, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, duration: 600 });
    const again = () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0, total: 0 });
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-ENTER', again);
    this.input.once('pointerdown', again);
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO, width: W, height: H, parent: document.body,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 0 } } },
  scene: [Game, Win]
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

    t(250, `Coins collected: ${this.total}/${all}`, 28);
    const r = t(340, 'Press ENTER or click to play again', 20);
    this.tweens.add({ targets: r, alpha: 0.3, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, duration: 600 });
    const again = () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0, total: 0 });
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-ENTER', again);
    this.input.once('pointerdown', again);
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO, width: W, height: H, parent: document.body,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 0 } } },
  scene: [Game, Win]
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

- **Controls:** arrow keys or A/D to move, Up/W/Space to jump. Press jump again in mid-air for the double jump.
- **Coins:** each level has 6–8 coins, and the HUD shows your count for the current level.
- **Enemy:** one red enemy per level patrols back and forth. Stomping it from above kills it and bounces you. Touching it any other way, or falling off the map, restarts the level and drops the coins you picked up there from your total.
- **Levels:** two levels with scrolling cameras. Reaching the green flag at the end of the first level takes you to the second.
- **Win screen:** reaching the second flag shows "YOU WIN!" and your total coins out of the maximum. Press Enter or click to play again.

There are no image files; the sprites are shapes drawn in code.
